chart.subtitle: Annual number of live births per 1,000 people in the total population.

Birth rate - Sex: all - Age: all - Varia.descriptionShort: The number of live births in a year per 1,000 people in the population.
descriptionKey: This is a *crude* birth rate — it is not adjusted for differences in age structure, so countries with younger populations tend to show higher rates even when individual women have the same number of children.
We also publish a [long-run birth rate indicator](https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/long-run-birth-rate) covering earlier years.
